title: LaneRegistry dispatch + watch blocks (design 02 §2)
description: Optional blocks on a config/lane_registry.json row. `dispatch` makes a movable lane schedulable by the generic dispatcher; absent or mode=off is inert. `watch` applies to every row (stay-behinds included) and tunes the heartbeat watcher.

cron.description: 5-field Vixie cron (no names, no @-macros, no L/#). Must equal the live crontab schedule while scheduler.kind=cron, and scheduler.cadence once kind=n8n. Empty only for purely event-triggered or digest-window lanes.

soft.description: Soft edge: run anyway at deadline (digest sender with --partial).

lane_id.description: run_done (required): upstream lane. A live lane counts the upstream's live RUN_DONE only; a dry_run (shadow) lane counts dry_run or live, as an `after` edge does (W5, 2026-10-11).

domain.description: broker_as_of (required, and only there): the Data Broker domain whose as_of advance fires the lane; one of scripts/lib/data_broker/as_of_signal.py DOMAINS (W5, CONSOLIDATION_PLAN §E.4).

require_verdict.description: run_done only (2026-10-16, process consolidation cohort 1): the upstream RUN_DONE fires this lane only when its receipt output_verdict.verdict is listed (scripts/lib/n8n_output_verdict.py). Absent = any RUN_DONE.

digest_window.description: Window id in config/digest_windows.json when this lane is a preparer or the sender.

stay_behind.description: True for broker/order/stop/secret/daemon/CIO lanes n8n must never run (watch only).

restart_safe.description: Reserved for rule R3 (governed restart); unused until ratified.
